Name: People Seeds
Author: Mizzion
Description:
[center][img]http://bwdy.wtf/content/sdv/peopleseeds/desc-header.png[/img][size=1]
[/size][/center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][b][code][/code][/b][/size][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][center][size=3][i]Very special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/60778376]AmuTsukiyomi[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/47049574]Riazaia[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/3027732]Glitchfinder[/url], and Yaro_Does for sprite contributions!
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51777556]MinervaMaga[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/3946892]MissCoriel[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/58777806]Eeveereest[/url] for their miscellaneous support[size=4]![/size][/i][/size][/center]
[size=3]People Seeds [/size][/b][/size][size=3]is a mod for Stardew Valley that is rather unlike other mods.  It enables a number of NPC-related shenanigans, and I make no guarantees it won't destroy your savegame - [b][i]so use it at your own risk[/i], [/b]or[b] [i]better yet just [u]back things up[/u][/i][/b] in case.
[/size][/font][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=2][b]
[/b][/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][line]
[font=Tahoma][size=5][b]FEATURES[/b][/size][/font]

[/size][/font][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Offering a [b]Golden Pumpkin[/b] to the Altar of Yoba will reward you with the [b]Wand of Transfiguration[/b].[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]The [b]Wand of Transfiguration[/b] will turn NPCs into items (and vice versa).[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Discovering all the trouble you can cause will be quite the experience, so I won't spoil it all here.[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][i][b]BUT[/b][/i]- as stated on the tin, you can, in fact, put these items into a [b]Seed Maker[/b], with rather predictable results.[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]If you'd like to return the NPC to whence you, uh, [i]collected [/i]them, take the NPC item to the Altar of Yoba.[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][i]If you think you've made a terrible mistake[/i], bring [b]Prismatic Shards[/b] to the Altar of Yoba and perhaps you can redeem yourself.[/size][/font][/font]
[/list]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[line]
[font=Tahoma][size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY
[/b]﻿[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]People Seeds is a very complex mod on the back-end of things.  So, naturally, there are some compatibility issues with other mods that are also complex. Here's the specifics I know of:
[/size][/font][/font][b]
[/b][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=3][i]spacechase0's [b]Cooking Skill[/b][/i] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/522]mods/522[/url]﻿[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=3][size=2]Their mod will spam errors on certain actions from this mod.
(It expects 'food data' that does not exist in this admittedly peculiar case.)[/size]

[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=3][i]spacechase0's [b]Magic[/b][/i][b] [/b]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2007]mods/2007[/url]﻿[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=3][size=2]Makes the altar of Yoba not respond to this mod (effectively making this mod unusable).
(it uses its own OnAction event for the altar which prevents this mod's from running)[/size]

[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=3][i]Platonymous's [b]Custom Furniture[/b][/i] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]mods/1254[/url]﻿[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=3][size=2]It segfaults on mac when trying to use machine recipes from this mod.
Does not leave enough log information to trace the source of the issue.[/size]

[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=3][i]Pathoschild's [b]Tractor[/b][/i][b] [/b]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]mods/1401[/url]﻿[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][size=2]Harvesting the crops surprisingly works fine.  However planting the seeds does not.
Tractor mod does not currently accept attachments from other mods, so it cannot be fixed from my end currently.[/size][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][/size][/font][/font]

[line][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[/size][/font][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]REQUIRES SMAPI.[/b][/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]REQUIRES BWDYWORKS.[/b][/size][/font][/font]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Decompress and drag the contained mod folder into your /[i]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/i] folder. That's it!
[/font][/size][/list]
[line]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][b]LICENSE[/b][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]

LICENSED UNDER MIT LICENSE[/b][/size][/font][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]You can update it! (Probably easier to just ask me, should I be spacing out.)[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]You can translate it! (Let me know if you do, I'll link from here!)[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]You can steal from it! (There's some cool code in there!)[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Credit is good manners, and appreciated ♥ (But not actually required.)[b][/b][/size][/font][/font]
[/list]
[line]
[center][url=http://bwdy.wtf/github/SDV-Moongates][img]http://bwdy.wtf/content/github.png[/img][/url][/center][center][url=http://bwdy.wtf/github/SDV-PeopleSeeds][/url][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b]
Seriously, thanks for checking out my mod(s)! I hope you love them as much as I do.
[/b][size=3]If you have any problems, let me know, I want to help! If you don't, consider endorsing the mod to help others find it.[/size][/size][/font][/font][/center]
